announcements.t: ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Directors/KMP/SMP/Auditor/RTA |SUBJECT: Change in Directors/KMP/SMP/Auditor/RTA

ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Re-appointment of Mr Yash Wardhan Jain as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. August 24, 2027. |SUBJECT: Appointment

ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Anil Kumar Nahata as Whole Time Director and CEO of the company w.e.f. August 13, 2026. |SUBJECT: Appointment

ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Re-appointment of Mr Sanjay Kumar Begani as Chairman & Managing Director of the company w.e.f. August 13, 2026. |SUBJECT: Appointment
ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company. |SUBJECT: Change in Auditors

ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results. |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2026 |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
